error_categories.description: Retrieval quality metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, MRR) decrease compared to the baseline Standard RAG configuration when running the Lifecycle-Guided strategy.
error_categories.observed_behavior: Under the Lifecycle-Guided strategy, context construction failed to retrieve any ground-truth target files for 8 out of 10 tasks, leading to zero F1-scores on those tasks.
error_categories.occurrence_frequency: Observed in 9 out of 10 tasks in the paired comparison evaluation.

supporting_evidence.observation: Entry nodes list was empty, indicating all candidate nodes fell below the similarity threshold.

No entry nodes passed the similarity threshold filter.
All semantic matches filtered out before graph traversal.

Verified that candidate B (similarity below threshold) was rejected, while candidate A (similarity above threshold) was accepted.

error_categories.description: Downstream or network-based service requests (such as embedding index queries or LLM requests) immediately propagate errors, causing execution failure when outages occur.
error_categories.observed_behavior: Simulating a transient exception (503) on strategy search immediately raised a ValueError and terminated the context construction pipeline.
error_categories.occurrence_frequency: Observed under simulated network fault conditions.

supporting_evidence.observation: Verified that strategy search propagates ValueError when the downstream API call encounters a transient exception.

error_categories.description: Evaluation metrics cannot be calculated if target_files ground truth metadata is missing from the task.
error_categories.observed_behavior: The diagnostics runner successfully completed retrieval for tasks missing target files, but recorded metrics as unavailable.

supporting_evidence.observation: Removing target_files from task definition allowed retrieval to execute, but prevented metrics from being computed.

error_categories.description: Process-level resource.getrusage() peak resident set size (ru_maxrss) measures cumulative peak usage and fails to isolate incremental strategy overhead.
error_categories.observed_behavior: Both RAG and Lifecycle strategies recorded near-identical peak RSS values of ~794 MB since the measurement represents the process-wide high water mark.
error_categories.recoverability: Not recoverable without changing the measurement methodology.
error_categories.occurrence_frequency: Observed consistently across all 10 evaluation tasks.

supporting_evidence.observation: The difference between Condition A and Condition B average RSS was only 0.54 MB, indicating cumulative process peak bias.
